tens_ones_group.name: Count by Making Tens
tens_ones_group.teaches: counting a large set by circling groups of ten, then counting tens and ones
tens_ones_group.representation: a scattered set of 20-50 objects; circle tens, write ___ tens ___ ones = ___

part_whole.name: Part-Whole Model
part_whole.teaches: parts and wholes: the cherry part-whole model, writing the four number sentences it shows, and finding a missing part
part_whole.representation: the bar/cherry part-whole diagram in B&W with one box empty; write the missing part or the number sentence

flex_partition.name: Partition Numbers Flexibly
flex_partition.teaches: partitioning a 2-, 3- or 4-digit number in more than one way (45 = 40 + 5 = 30 + 15), with base-10 and part-whole models
flex_partition.representation: a part-whole diagram with one part given; base-10 picture beside it; write the other part

nl_20.name: Numbers on a Number Line (any scale)
nl_20.teaches: the number line as a counting and place-value tool: count along, find, place and estimate numbers on 0-20, 0-50, 0-100, 0-1,000, 0-10,000 and 0-1,000,000 lines, counting in 1s, 10s, 100s ... and with only some ticks labelled
nl_20.representation: a drawn number line with some ticks labelled; write the number at the arrow, or mark a number; option: scale; option: estimate on a line with only the ends marked

compare_small.name: Compare Numbers to 10 and 20 (option)
compare_small.teaches: comparing and ordering numbers and groups of objects within 10 and 20 (and tens-and-ones pictures to 100) with <, >, = and the words greater than / less than / equal to (the lowest band today is 99)
compare_small.representation: band options 10 and 20 on placevalue:compare and the two order skills, a ten-frame or tens-and-ones picture support level

count_3s.name: Count in 3s
count_3s.teaches: counting forwards and backwards in 3s from 0 (the step before the 3 times-table)
count_3s.representation: a number track and a number line jumping in 3s; write the missing numbers

bonds_100.name: Bonds to 100
bonds_100.teaches: pairs of tens that make 100 (30 + 70) and later any pair (37 + 63), from bonds to 10
bonds_100.representation: a hundred square or bead string with part shaded; part-whole diagram; write the missing part

add_next_10.name: To the Next Ten
add_next_10.teaches: adding to reach the next multiple of 10 (38 + 2 = 40), then crossing it (38 + 5 = 38 + 2 + 3), and subtracting back to a ten (43 - 3)
add_next_10.representation: a number line with the ten marked; write the jump to the ten and then the rest

make_ten_subtract.name: Subtract Back Through Ten (option)
make_ten_subtract.teaches: subtracting within 20 by decomposing to a ten: 13 − 4 = 13 − 3 − 1 = 10 − 1
make_ten_subtract.representation: hop-line, bond; write the split and the answer in the step boxes

money_notes.name: Recognise Notes (option)
money_notes.teaches: recognising banknotes and their values alongside coins (the school teaches US dollars)
money_notes.representation: add notes to the coin-value picture bank

compare_sentences.name: Compare Number Sentences
compare_sentences.teaches: comparing two expressions with <, > or = by reasoning, not only calculating (7 + 5 ___ 7 + 6)
compare_sentences.representation: two expressions with a circle between; write <, > or =

equal_sign_repair.option: route the skill to its own generator (it deals plain column addition today) and add the forms 6 = 6, 7 = 8 − 1, 5 + 2 = 2 + 5, 4 + 1 = 5 + 2
equal_sign_repair.name: True or False Equations (repair)
equal_sign_repair.teaches: the equal sign means "the same as"; deciding whether equations with + and − on either side are true or false
equal_sign_repair.representation: equation; tick True or False; write the number

shape_sort.name: Sort 2-D and 3-D Shapes
shape_sort.teaches: sorting shapes by one property (sides, corners, flat or curved faces, rolls or stacks) and naming the sorting rule
shape_sort.representation: shape tiles and two labelled sorting rings or a Carroll-style two-box table

shape_3d_tasks.name: What Can This Shape Do?
shape_3d_tasks.teaches: properties of 3-D shapes in use: roll, stack, slide; flat and curved faces; faces seen in 3-D shapes
shape_3d_tasks.representation: line drawings of 3-D shapes; tick roll/stack/slide; match the face print to the 3-D shape

scenes.name: Copy and Build
scenes.teaches: copying a picture or construction made of shapes, visualising from another viewpoint, replicating a scene
scenes.representation: a model picture made of shapes beside an empty frame; draw or choose the matching copy

shape_draw.name: Draw 2-D Shapes
shape_draw.teaches: drawing 2-D shapes on a dot grid from a name or a description (4 sides, 2 long and 2 short)
shape_draw.representation: a square dot grid; draw the shape; the key shows one correct drawing

symmetry_complete.name: Complete the Symmetric Shape
symmetry_complete.teaches: using a vertical line of symmetry to complete a shape or pattern on a square grid
symmetry_complete.representation: half a shape on squared paper beside a dashed mirror line; draw the other half

shape_faces.name: Faces, Edges or Vertices (option)
shape_faces.teaches: counting faces, edges and vertices of 3-D shapes one property per page (the skill mixes them)
shape_faces.representation: a "count" option: faces / edges / vertices / mixed

money_uk.name: Count Money (option)
money_uk.teaches: counting notes and coins together and in dollars and cents, choosing coins to make an amount, making the same amount two ways
money_uk.representation: options on money_count / equiv_coin_sets: notes, dollars-and-cents mode, "make it two ways"

nonstandard_mass.name: Measure Mass with Cubes
nonstandard_mass.teaches: measuring mass with non-standard units (cubes, marbles) on a balance, and comparing masses by the count
nonstandard_mass.representation: a drawn balance with an object in one pan and cubes in the other; write how many cubes

money_2step.name: Two-Step Money Problems
money_2step.teaches: two-step money word problems (buy two items, then find the change)
money_2step.representation: a price list drawn as tags plus a short story; bar model support level

tagFixes.why: partial: grouping loose objects into tens to count them (the skill shows ready-made tens rods)
the skill deals plain column addition today (build-list equal_sign_repair); it does not compare two number sentences
